name: Network_proximity
description: Graph distance between two node sets on a user-supplied network, with the standard measures from Guney/Barabasi (2016) and Menche (2015) plus a degree-matched random Z-score. Domain-agnostic: any two node sets on any graph (drug targets vs disease module, two pathways, two marker sets, …). Give the network as inline 'edges' pairs or a 2-column 'edgelist_path', plus two node sets ('set_a'/'set_b', or the drug-pharmacology aliases 'targets'/'disease_genes'). measure='closest' (default), 'shortest', or 'separation' (s_AB<0 = overlapping modules). Returns the value, Z-score, and empirical p. Pure networkx+numpy, no network call or API key.

edges.description: Network as inline [source, target] node-id pairs (undirected). Use for small/medium graphs.

edgelist_path.description: Alternative to inline: path to a 2-column edgelist (.tsv/.txt = tab, else comma)

measure.description: Distance measure: 'closest' (default, Guney), 'shortest' (all-pairs mean), or 'separation' (Menche s_AB)

return_schema.description: Network proximity (Guney/Barabasi 'closest'/'shortest' or Menche 'separation') between two node sets, with a degree-matched random Z-score and empirical p-value.

n_set_a_in_network.description: Number of set_a nodes found in the network.

n_set_b_in_network.description: Number of set_b nodes found in the network.

nodes_in_network.description: Total number of nodes in the network.

missing_set_a.description: set_a nodes not found in the network.

missing_set_b.description: set_b nodes not found in the network.

z_score.description: Z-score of the observed value against the degree-matched random null.

random_mean.description: Mean of the degree-matched random null distribution.

random_std.description: Standard deviation of the degree-matched random null distribution.
